newsitem.title: SPAIN: Arafat warns Israel against war with Syria.
newsitem.headline: Arafat warns Israel against war with Syria.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat warned Israel on Thursday that any military conflict with Syria would imperil the entire Middle East peace process.
Speaking at a news conference in Madrid, Arafat said he was committed to the peace process and confident it would prevail over any "temptations" to revert to war.
Asked how he would view a limited military conflict between Israel and Syria, Arafat responded: "I think this would be a very dangerous adventure and very serious for the entire peace process.

"We know that, a few days ago, the Israeli army carried out military manoeuvres on the Golan Heights. We know there are troop concentrations in that area. But we are also convinced that peace and the work to achieve peace will be much stronger than any other temptations."

Arafat called peace with Israel a "strategic alternative". His Palestine Liberation Organisation gave up decades of fruitless armed struggle to win an independent state for a 1993 peace deal with Israel which gave Palestinians a degree of self rule in Gaza and part of the West Bank.
Israeli sceptics say the peace deal was merely the first phase of a Palestinian plan to get back all Israeli territory in addition to the Palestinian territories.
